stuckLoads.what: Intermittent silent stuck data load on cockpits: the page paints a complete, confident PRE-DATA state and sometimes never replaces it — with zero console errors, zero failed requests, no persistent spinner and no retry affordance
stuckLoads.evidence: /workspace/assistants held 964-1077 chars past settle + >=12s fixed wait in BOTH main desktop passes, while five later loads reached 102,305-120,696 chars; /workspace/frontend-revenue held 988 chars past 12s on 1 of 5 loads (others 56,493-58,702, byte-stable across 3 confirmation loads). Observed stuck: ~3 of 13 cockpit loads this session
stuckLoads.why_it_is_worse_than_a_spinner: the stuck state ASSERTS false diagnostics as settled fact: 'No token detected - 0/3 lanes ready', red 'Needs GH_GENERAL_TOKEN' readiness cards, 'Showing 0/0', 'No events yet', and header 'ONLINE' — the loaded state says 'GitHub connected @iMelki - 3/3 lanes ready', 'Showing 588/588', header 'OFFLINE'. Screenshots: workspace_assistants-desktop.png (stuck) vs workspace_assistants-desktop-loaded.png (loaded)
stuckLoads.relation_to_prior: R15 booked composite 1.6 5.0->4.5 for the transient form of this exact class ('a wrong answer presented as settled is worse than a spinner'); at ac94d73 the transient form persists and a stuck-indefinite form was additionally observed

gauntlet.scale: frontend-sota-gauntlet 7 areas x 0-3, total /21; first-ever MCK gauntlet measurement, all areas MEASURED, nothing carried

visualDirection.why: Coherent, polished mono-terminal operator identity (JetBrains Mono everywhere, rgb(13,17,23) dark tokens, consistent mc-* badge/panel language, no pure #000, real data). Not 3: several saturated accents compete (blue CTA, cyan, green, amber, pink feed, violet stat), h1 hierarchy inconsistent across routes (16px cockpit h1 vs 24/30px elsewhere), and the 2.87:1 muted class dulls the polish.

uxClarity.why: Clear and scannable: labeled tab shell, breadcrumbs, honest counts ('Showing 588/588'), exemplary inbox safety-gate copy naming exactly what to fill in. Not 3: pre-data states actively mislead (stuck cockpits assert wrong answers), and jargon leaks ('Stale proof', 'post-migration', '0/3 lanes ready').

motionInteractivity.why: Motion supports content with real restraint: only busy-state spinners; fleet motion primitive adopted — spin 1000ms swaps to fleet-busy-pulse 1600ms under reduce with information parity proven. Not 3: no signature moment anywhere in the nine surfaces.

technicalQuality.why: Solid: 0 page errors, console clean on 17/18 units, proven-zero overflow, honest offline handling of a genuinely down gateway, TanStack-backed table, working roving-tabs a11y. Explicitly NOT 3 because the failure fallback has a hole: cockpit data loads can stick silently in a false pre-data state (~3/13 loads) with no error path, and card titles clip long tokens.

responsiveness.why: 375x812 genuinely adapted (stacked cockpit, wrapped tab pills, usable board), 0px overflow and control-proven clipping zeros at both viewports. Capped at 2 by the standing fleet rule: two viewports are a scoped receipt, not multi-viewport quality; no 15x4 matrix, no AT/manual.

verification.why: Browser-evidenced end to end: 18 units, screenshots, console, in-run positive AND negative controls for overflow/clipping/contrast sentinels, reduced-motion contexts with parity, keyboard pass. Capped at 2 by the same standing rule (Verification stays 2 until 15x4 + AT/manual); axe not run this session.

complexityFit.why: An operator kanban cockpit at operator density — no overbuild, no 3D/cinematic excess; complexity is carried by real GitHub Projects data and dispatch gates. Not 3: fit is evident but not argued anywhere as a chosen level with its proof burden, and the stuck-load class undercuts 'fully proved'.

gauntlet.band: usable (14-18); 5 points below the 19/21 strong-benchmark floor
gauntlet.comparableFleetRows: component-marketplace 14, memsys console 15, hermes 15, command-center 18, openai-proxy 21 — MCK's 14 is a full-app 9-surface measure, not a login-only or locked-shell row

awwwardsComposite.scale: fleet 0-10 ledger (uiux-fleet-rescore-2026-08-12.md); dims folded per the ledger's own validated formula: Design=mean(1.1,1.2,1.4), Usability=mean(1.3,1.5,1.6), Creativity=1.8, Content=1.7; weights 0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1

1.1_visualCraft.why: coherent dark token system, mono hierarchy, real content; multiple accents and uneven h1 scale hold it at the 6 anchor

1.2_motionInteraction.why: reduced-motion honored with a working alternative (fleet primitive, parity proven), transform/opacity only; no signature choreography, hover/press cycles not exhaustively measured. Down 0.5 from the carried 7.0 — the carry predates the fleet's RM measurement era and nothing above the 6 anchor was demonstrable beyond the RM excellence

1.3_iaUserFlows.why: separated routes, unique headers, counts on sliced lists, progressive disclosure, working keyboard path incl. roving tabs; no command palette, decision-in-one-glance undermined by pre-data states (priced in 1.6)

1.4_designSystem.why: components.json + DataTable-on-TanStack pattern (rubric §4), uniform mc-* primitives across all nine rendered surfaces, no visible same-purpose divergence; known n8n table leak persists

1.5_accessibility.why: UP 0.5 from 5.0: skip link shipped (2.4.1 mechanism exists), roving-tab indicators fixed (mck#150 closed class), 67/68 tab stops with visible indicator, 100%-coverage contrast measurement. Held below 6: the 2.87:1 timestamp class persists at hundreds of elements per cockpit, OFFLINE badge 4.05:1, raw under-24 controls on settings sort headers, 2.5.5 AAA broadly unmet, axe not run

1.6_perceivedPerformance.why: explicit net-zero HOLD: warm TTFB 71-125ms / DCL 107-273ms and fast warm reloads (up-pressure) cancel against the same R15 wrong-answer class now also observed as stuck-indefinite silent loads with false diagnostics (~3/13 cockpit loads)

1.7_contentMicrocopy.why: real data everywhere, honest failure states, empty states carry the next step, relative dates, counts; operatorese leaks and the stuck state's false copy (priced in 1.6) keep it at 6.5

1.8_delight.why: nothing measurably signature; the calm-density inbox gate is the closest moment. No movement invented

awwwardsComposite.deltaVsLedger: ledger carried MCK 5.7167 (prints 5.7) from R15; first full re-measure lands 5.70 — unrounded -0.0167, printed tenth UNCHANGED at 5.7. Internal movement is real and cancels: 1.5 +0.5 (measured fixes), 1.2 -0.5, others hold
awwwardsComposite.awardBarHonesty: 5.70 is 0.80 BELOW the published Awwwards Honorable Mention bar of 6.5. No award claim is made, and none would be defensible. Gauntlet 14/21 and composite 5.7 are stated on their own scales and NOT cross-walked

honestLimits: Run mode is next dev --webpack, not a production build; production next build is known-broken on origin/dev (scripts/derive-captured-surfaces.ts:426, fix stranded on feature/a11y-focus-proof-150) so a prod-serve measure was impossible without source/branch mutation, which this lane is forbidden
Cold-compile first-hit numbers are not trustworthy as 'cold': the server had been up and mostly pre-compiled; recorded curl first-hits (69ms-2.44s) are labeled as session-first-hit only
axe was not run this session; the a11y picture rests on this lane's own probes plus the repo's committed baselines
Target-size raw counts are pre-exception; 2.5.8 exception adjudication (spacing/inline) was not performed, so no 2.5.8 pass/fail verdict is claimed
Hover/press interaction cycles, command-latency (sub-100ms) sampling, and frame-rate profiling were not measured
Contrast enumerates elements with direct text nodes; gradient/image backgrounds were excluded as unresolved (counted in denominators where present)
The stuck-load rate (~3/13) is a small-sample observation across one session, not a statistically settled frequency

Mobile pass used one settle+10s window; mobile assistants unit's settle-time text (1011) vs audit-time controls (1203) shows the audit ran post-arrival — per-field timing inside that unit is mixed-state and only the audit-time numbers are quoted

Composite 1.4 leans on standing code facts (components.json, TanStack DataTable) from the fleet rubric's app notes; rendered-surface consistency was measured, the code facts were not re-derived this session
